title: Online Sketched Newton-Raphson
summary: In online convex optimization (OCO), a decision-maker is confronted with an unknown environment and seeks to play an optimal sequence of decisions on a short time-scale using only past information. Recent advances in second-order OCO methods have demonstrated tighter regret bounds and improved empirical performance over traditional first-order methods. However, this performance comes at a cost: a matrix inversion is now required, which scales with the cube of the size of the problem. In this work, we propose sketching to mitigate this limitation.
